narration:0:1826059001:0.text: You and Zorya venture into the crypt with the unconscious Tephesia in tow...
narration:0:1826059001:0.source_cn: 你们带着昏迷的苔佩希，进入了莫蒂默家族地宫……
narration:0:1826059001:0.male: You and Zorya venture into the crypt with the unconscious Tephesia in tow...
narration:0:1826059001:0.female: You and Zorya venture into the crypt with the unconscious Tephesia in tow...

say:3:1826059002:1.text: The air is thick with the power of death, and countless coffins hang overhead from iron chains.
say:3:1826059002:1.source_cn: 神秘的地宫中，充斥着浓烈的死亡之力。无数棺材被铁链悬挂...

say:4:1826059003:1.text: Despite the dim light, you can make out four coffins resting on a raised platform. At the very top lies an exquisite coffin, tightly sealed and shrouded in an unsettling silence.
say:4:1826059003:1.source_cn: 尽管光线非常昏暗，但你依然能看清，高台上放置着四口棺材...
say:4:1826059003:1.male: Despite the dim light, you can make out four coffins resting on a raised platform. At the very top lies an exquisite coffin, tightly sealed and shrouded in an unsettling silence.
say:4:1826059003:1.female: Despite the dim light, you can make out four coffins resting on a raised platform. At the very top lies an exquisite coffin, tightly sealed and shrouded in an unsettling silence.

say:5:1826059004:1.text: Behind it, an artifact glows with an eerie green light, steadily releasing mana.
say:5:1826059004:1.source_cn: 在它背后，一个散发着幽绿色光芒的装置在源源不绝地向外输...

say:6:1826059005:0.text: The artifact looks strangely familiar. Regardless, you know it holds immense power... Could it be the sacred relic Eryndor mentioned earlier?
say:6:1826059005:0.source_cn: 不知为何，你对它似乎有一种熟悉感。除此以外，你唯一能确...
say:6:1826059005:0.male: The artifact looks strangely familiar. Regardless, you know it holds immense power... Could it be the sacred relic Eryndor mentioned earlier?
say:6:1826059005:0.female: The artifact looks strangely familiar. Regardless, you know it holds immense power... Could it be the sacred relic Eryndor mentioned earlier?

say:8:1826059006:0.text: <style="highlight">Only one coffin lies open</style>. It must be Mordred's.
say:8:1826059006:0.male: <style="highlight">Only one coffin lies open</style>. It must be Mordred's.
say:8:1826059006:0.female: <style="highlight">Only one coffin lies open</style>. It must be Mordred's.

say:9:1826059007:1.text: Quick, get her into the coffin and let her rest. Meanwhile, I'll investigate how this crypt supplies mana to the vampires.
say:9:1826059007:1.source_cn: 尽快让她躺进去休息。我会抓紧时间研究清楚这座地宫如何帮...
say:9:1826059007:1.male: Quick, get her into the coffin and let her rest. Meanwhile, I'll investigate how this crypt supplies mana to the vampires.
say:9:1826059007:1.female: Quick, get her into the coffin and let her rest. Meanwhile, I'll investigate how this crypt supplies mana to the vampires.

narration:10:1826059008:0.text: You gently lay Tephesia in her coffin.
narration:10:1826059008:0.source_cn: 你将苔佩希放入她的棺材
narration:10:1826059008:0.male: You gently lay Tephesia in her coffin.
narration:10:1826059008:0.female: You gently lay Tephesia in her coffin.

narration:11:1826059009:0.text: Some time later, Zorya returns to your side.
narration:11:1826059009:0.source_cn: 半晌之后，佐尔娅回到你身边
narration:11:1826059009:0.male: Some time later, Zorya returns to your side.
narration:11:1826059009:0.female: Some time later, Zorya returns to your side.
